title: FDA approves MDMA-assisted therapy for PTSD
proposition: FDA approves midomafetamine (MDMA-assisted therapy) for PTSD.
criterion: TRUE on the date of the FDA approval letter for midomafetamine for PTSD. A complete response letter is not an approval.

title: FDA approves COMP360 for treatment-resistant depression
proposition: FDA approves COMP360 (psilocybin) for treatment-resistant depression or major depressive disorder.
criterion: TRUE on the date of the FDA approval letter. A rolling submission or a filing acceptance is not an approval.

title: MAPP1 meets its primary endpoint
proposition: MAPS PBC reports that MAPP1 met its primary endpoint (CAPS-5 change vs placebo).
criterion: TRUE on the date of the sponsor's topline release or the first publication reporting the primary endpoint as met.

title: Three or more at-home depression treatment devices authorized in the US
proposition: The count of FDA-authorized at-home depression treatment devices on the US market is at or beyond 3 by the period end.
criterion: Resolved on the FDA 510(k) and De Novo databases: devices with a home-use indication for depression that are marketed in the US. Realized values are stored, not scored.

quantity.metric: FDA-authorized at-home depression treatment devices on the US market
quantity.series: FDA 510(k) and De Novo databases, fixture count

title: First ERISA suit citing mental health parity is filed
proposition: A lawsuit under ERISA that pleads mental health parity violations is filed in a US federal court.
criterion: TRUE on the docket date of the first complaint that pleads a fiduciary breach under ERISA grounded in mental health parity.

title: DEA extends telemedicine flexibilities beyond 2024
proposition: DEA publishes a rule extending the COVID-era telemedicine flexibilities for controlled substances past 2024-12-31.
criterion: TRUE on the Federal Register publication date of an extension rule.

title: FDA approves Spravato as monotherapy for TRD
proposition: FDA approves esketamine nasal spray as a monotherapy for treatment-resistant depression.
criterion: TRUE on the date of the FDA supplemental approval letter that adds the monotherapy indication.

title: A national payer covers accelerated TMS in outpatient clinics
proposition: A national commercial payer publishes a coverage policy for accelerated TMS protocols in the outpatient setting.
criterion: TRUE on the effective date of a published payer policy bulletin that covers an accelerated TMS protocol.

title: FDA clears Relivion for major depressive disorder
proposition: FDA grants clearance or De Novo authorization for Relivion for major depressive disorder.
criterion: TRUE on the decision date in the FDA 510(k) or De Novo database with a depression indication.

title: EMA approves MDMA-assisted therapy for PTSD
proposition: The European Commission grants marketing authorization for midomafetamine for PTSD.
criterion: TRUE on the date of the European Commission decision.

title: Compass reports COMP360 phase 2b topline
proposition: Compass Pathways reports topline results of its phase 2b COMP360 trial in treatment-resistant depression.
criterion: TRUE on the date of the sponsor's topline press release.

title: FDA approves Cobenfy as adjunctive treatment for schizophrenia
proposition: FDA approves xanomeline-trospium as an adjunctive treatment for schizophrenia.
criterion: TRUE on the date of the FDA supplemental approval letter for the adjunctive indication.
